50055.x: Curinginnos. Inc. (CEO Kweon Yechan) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

As such, we developed the iVOLVE system so that people can systematically and freely enjoy tennis even when alone.”

Around 80% of the data produced today is unstructured data that is difficult for artificial intelligence models to learn directly, so it is necessary to preprocess the data to make it suitable for machine learning for the purpose of artificial intelligence development. As Crowdworks’ artificial intelligence learning data preprocessing platform, ‘Workstage’ contributes to securing and improving customer’s AI performance by easily gathering and processing AI learning data necessary for the customer’s AI model development.

According to a PALSOO representative, “Plasma activated water technology is environmentally harmless, free of residual toxicity and carcinogenic by-products. They added, “In the post-COVID-19 era, the virus keeps generating variants. It is difficult to predict when the pandemic will end, and the likelihood of its prolongation is growing, requiring continued sterilization and disinfection. However, most disinfectant sprayers are not suitable for use as a refill of disinfectant solution due to the ongoing costs and inconvenience in storage. Sometimes, they're just not a viable for the purpose of being prepared ahead of time.” The representative emphasized, “Plasma wireless atomizer PALSOO, scheduled to be released in February 2023, is a social utility product that can be used in an emergency at any time, even when disinfectant solution is not readily available or ready for use.”

50062.x: Robogram Co., Ltd. (CEO Lim Sang Hee) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Robogram is an edutech business that develops fun and efficient educational content. Their educational content is all about “how to” satisfy “who” and “how much.” The company’s focus is not on the top 20% students but the remaining 80% who find coding difficult and on successful algorithmic education for this larger group. The startup established an overseas branch in Singapore in November, 2022

In this year’s CES, Robogram introduced block coding software that makes it easy for anyone to develop 3D games without any programming knowledge. The outputs can be shared with the world and monetized to ensure that learners are motivated. The business offer users with free LMS service for coding training to enable self-directed learning and frequently give away cyber money to encourage users learn coding.

The purpose of coding training is to develop the ability to solve problems by using a computer. A Robogram representative said, "In order for a computer to work, you have to set the order of things, and the efficiency of work is determined by the flowchart. The most effective means of determining flowcharts is algorithms, and coding is aimed at improving algorithmic capabilities. To this end, you need to create a variety programs in a computer language. It can be difficult for beginners to perform text coding, so we are introducing block coding, which makes it easier to create outputs.”

However, block coding centered around hardware control requires a high initial cost whereas the most widely used Scratch produces 2D outputs, which are not as interesting to draw learners’ attention long enough. Addressing these drawbacks, Robogram developed JEM S to enable anyone to easily create 3D games and metaverse worlds using the Roblox engine, which has the largest number of users worldwide.

JEM S allows more than 20 lines of Lua text code to be expressed in a single block code so that even beginners can learn block coding and algorithms for an extended period of time, making 3D sandbox games and having fun. Learners' output, made with affordable software fees, can be shared with more than 100 million users around the world through Roblox Store.

As of December 2022, JEM S was distributed to 300 schools across South Korea, and the accumulated number of users exceeds 30,000. Having started with the Asian market in 2022, the business is planning to expand to the North American market in 2023 and to European in 2024.

Its IoT-based AI air quality sensor AirDeep analyzes indoor air quality in real time to detect air pollution factors such as dust, fine dust, smoke, and abnormalities. The solution’s strength lies in applying machine learning and deep learning algorithms instead of expensive and sophisticated hardware. AI algorithms can improve the accuracy of air quality sensing and detection. With AI, it is relatively easy to reconstruct functions and logic, and it is also cheaper than physical sensors.

The indicator flashes blue, green, or red to signal good, normal, or bad air quality, respectively, while AI offers guidance about optimized air quality improvement based on the results of air quality pattern analysis. According to a representative from AirDeep, “For example, if there is air pollution from cooking, it would recommend to run the range hood. If smoking is detected, it would suggest not to smoke in that area.

We have been working on fine dust management and AI-based air quality analysis when conducting various projects. In this process, we realized the field of air quality needs to be accessible to everyone, transcending the barrier of languages around the world. That is why we decided to get into this business.”

Having supplied South Korea’s major car sharing services such as SOCAR and PEOPLECAR, the startup has recently partnered with one of Korea’s giant mobile carriers, KT, and initiated the development of an indoor air quality information provider through Smart TV.

AirDeep plans to implement the following features in the next version: 1) automatic control of air quality manager using the IR remote communication technology, and 2) edge computing.

Human Performance Lab is a company created in the biomechanics laboratory of Ewha Womans University, led by CEO Taeyong Lee, an expert in biomechanics. Under the vision of ‘Anytime, anywhere, anyone, every day is comfortable’, we research and develop contact-free customized insoles based on computer vision technology and computing simulation technology using numerical analysis. Through this, the difficulty of people with foot or lower limb pain having to visit the hospital or the store is being solved.

They were selected for the prospective startup package conducted by the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development (KISED) and developed the MVP version of the customized insole production application ‘FitSole’ and was selected as the best company in the final inspection and was honored with a reward.

Human Performance Lab’s ‘FitSole’, which is based on 3D conversion algorithms and computer simulations, is a contact-free customized insole manufacturing system. The company explains that “perfectly customized insoles” and “contact-free foot measurement” are the key functions. FitSole produces customized insoles through filming a video of the foot surface only (around 10 seconds). Additionally, it uses FEM (Finite Element Method) walking simulation to choose the optimal shape and material. Accordingly, Human Performance Lab pointed out that it has the advantage of reducing 70% of the time it takes to measure the foot through FitSole, and that customized insoles can be provided to customers at a reasonable price by reducing labor costs.

A Human Performance Lab representative explained, “The insole is a part of the shoe that directly comes into contact with the sole (bottom of the foot) and plays a role in cushioning and shock absorption, greatly affecting the wearer’s gait and the comfort of the shoe. A generic insole that does not consider individual physical characteristics can lead to incorrect walking and increase the risk of foot and ankle diseases such as plantar fasciitis and intoe(hallux valgus), as well as various chronic diseases such as disc herniation and spinal diseases.”

He added, “Customized insoles that are tailored to the different shapes of people’s soles have an effect on gait correction and foot and heel pain relief and are particularly effective for people who experience persistent pain. Customized insoles are becoming more popular, but they are time-consuming and expensive to manufacture. Our company recognized this and developed the app ‘FitSole’, which allows users to order customized insoles through their smartphones and have them delivered to their doorstep.

In addition, we aim to form a global partnership with Philips, and we would like to hold technical meetings with ‘Orthosensor’, a company that has the technology to periodically check and diagnose patients with feet and leg diseases in our target group. We are planning to develop slippers that reflect the curves of our feet in the future. In addition, we will further challenge the sports market, such as golf shoes and tennis shoes, using the data and technology we have accumulated.”

Dongnamrealize produces CXP wood, a material capable of thermoplastic molding such as injection and extrusion. The firm aims to establish a culture where all members engaged in the production and consumption of wood can easily participate in benefiting forests.

As a material usable in existing plastic factories, CXP wood can replace most plastic products used in our everyday life with wooden products. The by-products bound to be generated in the process of forestry and agriculture are processed and distributed in a form that can be melted in plants. This reduces waste from the forestry industry and helps reduce the absolute quantity of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere by storing carbon through productization, according to Dongnamrealize.

The CXP flame-retardant wooden power strip to be introduced for this exhibition does not easily catch fire, even though it is made of wood. This user-friendly product passes the usual high-temperature flame-retardant tests and emits no toxicity to fire with a low temperature that can happen in daily life.

A Dongnamrealize representative explained, “Our desire was to change people’s prejudice against wood that they are vulnerable to fire and difficult to use. “Since the first launch of CXP material in August last year, we have achieved sales of KRW 1 billion in 2022 within a year and our products got into more than 100 zero-waist (green) shops.” They added “Partnerships are underway with large enterprises from home and abroad to see where the products can be applied. 50079.x: LiBEST (CEO Kim Joo-Seong) participated in ‘CES 2023’, held in Las Vegas, USA for 4 days between January 5th (Thurs) and 8th (Sun, local time).
LiBEST, a flexible secondary battery manufacturing startup, won the Innovation Award at CES 2023 for their flame retardant and cold resistant battery manufacturing technology.

The fact that the performance of batteries diminishes when temperatures are below 0 degrees (Celsius), like it is these days, is widely known. This has a big effect on the usage time of smartphones and also on the driving distance of EVs. An official of LiBEST explained that, “If temperatures drop even further, you may even experience inoperability. This may lead you to think the product is broken, but it’s normally a battery issue. When temperatures drop, the electrolytes freeze, and this leads to decreased conductivity of lithium ions. This is the reason why lithium-ion batteries normally can only operate at 40~70% of their normal capacity in sub-zero temperatures.”

The flame retardant and cold resistant battery manufacturing technology proposed by LiBEST is unique. The NMC and graphite was used as they were for the anode and cathode, but they combined LiBEST’s special electrolyte and separator film. As such, it has the strengths of maintaining the voltage and high energy density of batteries while gaining the characteristics of flame retardancy and cold resistance.

In regular batteries, when the electrolytes in batteries are directly exposed to flames of around 1,300˚C, regular electrolytes quickly catch fire, and the fire is sustained until all of the electrolytes are burned up. An official of the company explained that, even in the same situation, LiBEST’s electrolytes take much longer to catch fire, like other flame retardant materials, and has the characteristic of being easily extinguishable even when it catches fire, preventing direct combustion at the battery cell level.

Thus, even if there are fires in individual battery cells, it prevents the fire from spreading to the battery pack or the whole, and even if there is a fire in the battery from an accident with the EV, it prevents the fires from spreading to the whole car and even prevents explosions from occurring.

In addition to such flame-retardant properties, it also has cold resistance properties. The electrolyte in the battery that LiBEST is currently developing is able to operate at -40˚C, a temperature that it is impossible for other batteries to operate in, and was shown to charge and discharge normally even in temperatures between –10˚C and –20˚C. In addition, despite being a battery for BEV (battery electric vehicle) with high energy density, it showed a retention capacity of over 90% even after 500 phases of charging and discharging.

An official revealed that, “If you just look at the traits, it appears to be far from commercialization. However, the technical maturity is at the level of TRL 6 and is actually not that far off. Unlike solid-state batteries, which are still slow to commercialize, our batteries can be manufactured using conventional manufacturing processes. As such, it can go into mass production much faster than solid-state batteries and be applied in our lives in general.”

Its range of application is wide too. It can be applied on the flexible batteries, which are one of LiBEST’s main products, to be used to strengthen the safety of VR/AR and metaverse devices or healthcare and medical devices. The smaller batteries with a capacity of 1~5Ah can be applied to delivery robots or drones which are used outdoors and can be derived into a battery system for use in military or special environments as well. It can also be easily applied into pouch or cylindrical types and is expected to be able to be used in urban air mobility (UAM), electric vehicles (EV), or energy storage systems (ESS) when made as a medium-sized or large batteries.
This product was displayed in the LiBEST’s booth for CES at the Las Vegas Convention Center’s Central Hall as well as the Innovation Awards Showcase at The Venetian.

As a gas separation membrane company, AIRRANE is cementing its place as a one-stop service provider, manufacturing hollow fiber membranes and separation membrane modules that use them, as well as providing separation system design, manufacturing, and technical services. Since its establishment in 2002, it has operated with the company vision of developing as a sustainable eco-friendly energy solution company of the future in the field of gas separation membranes through endless innovation.
They introduced new technology that drastically reduces processing times compared to existing processes by using gas separation membranes in CO2 capturing processes and biogas upgrading processes.

Gas separation membranes are in the form of tiny hollow fibers that allow various types of gas mixtures to pass. When gas mixtures pass through the hollow fibers, the separation membranes inside the hollow fibers separate the gases through the selective permeation phenomenon according to absorption-diffusion mechanisms.

It does not require auxiliary media, such as water, solvents, or adsorbents, and has the advantage of easily being able to install the module without the need for shutting down for long periods of time. In addition, it takes up very little space in installation, boasting high space efficiency.

Founded in a state designated separation membrane laboratory and growing into a company specializing in gas separation membranes, AIRRANE built up their technical capabilities as they supplied advanced overseas companies, like Air Products and Asahi Glass, in the early stages of their business. With public companies like Korea Gas Technology Corporation and Korea District Heating Corporation gaining in interest in the fields of carbon capturing and gas filtering after 2010, they began their business in Korea, recording growth of 19% in sales and 209% in exports in 2020.

For the future, they have plans to develop materials and large modules for separation membranes, produce green hydrogen by reforming biogas and supply this to hydrogen charging stations or for fuel cell power generation, and optimize processes to minimize energy and cost used in CO2 capturing.

Mago Presents GyroSpeed to Help Efficient Pitch Training in CES 2023

Sports tech start-up Mago has recently introduced a product called GyroSpeed to the market. GyroSpeed detects the starting and ending points of the user’s pitching action by using a gyro sensor to calculate the maximum acceleration per interval, along with another gyro sensor to measure acceleration This feature predicts the user’s pitching speed and displays the data on the OLED screen mounted on the product.

The technology that facilitates pitching training is the essence of this product. Users can intuitively check the changes in ball speed based on the velocity of the arm movement, and the immediate feedback enhances engagement and motivation for training. Also, it automatically saves the number of exercises so that users can view their training hours. If necessary, users may set a separate goal for goal-driven and systematic training.

According to Mago's CEO Tae hoon Kim, “We desperately need tools to assist consistent training while reducing the risk of injury in order to boost pitching ability. However, existing products in the market have not been improved in terms of performance for a long time, and they were dependent on the user's perseverance.” Kim added, “That is why we came up with a product that would expand the market and help newcomers maintain their interests in baseball. GyroSpeed is the one solution satisfies those needs.”

“From this CES, the largest of the various global exhibitions, we expect to find buyers who will be responsible for the distribution of GyroSpeed in the U.S. online sports marketplace,” Kim explained. “We also intend to increase synergies for crowdfunding in the United States through active promotion of our products.”
BEOMJUN E&C Announces New Technology Utilizing Waste Sulfur in CES 2023

BEOMJUN E&C is a business that develops new technologies to reform waste sulfur, an industrial product generated during the oil refining process, to use and process it as concrete and asphalt additives. The green growth leader is approved by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for their technology.

At the exhibition, the company will introduce modification sulfur cement concrete additive (SU⁺ C100). This is a highly functional and eco-friendly cement concrete additive manufactured by using a modifier in DCPD discharged from a petrochemical plant and sulfur generated as crude oil, and gas purification by-products. Their product has been designated as a new and excellent national technology and awarded the Great King Sejong Prize. In addition, the asphalt concrete modifier (SU⁺ A100) is an eco-friendly asphalt binder with better elongation, utilizing sulfur by-products.

Furthermore, BEOMJUN E&C developed an eco-friendly process called PBI (Protect Black Ice) which uses 0% of calcium chloride. It is available for long-period use in a single construction project by adding materials that absorb and release the temperature of the road surface according to the atmospheric environment of the micro-sulfur biome product, thus boosting the strength of road pavement job. The environmentally-friendly process mixes calcium, magnesium, and acetate (CMA) with a porous material and a phase change material (PCM) instead of antifreeze substances such as salt and calcium chloride. Since it prevents freezing from -1 C to -4 C degrees, traffic accidents caused by black ice are prevented.

According to a representative from BEOMJUN E&C, “In this CES, we want to spread the competitiveness of our differentiated products along with the importance of an environmentally friendly construction industry through the use of high performance concrete and asphalt additives.” They added “We will continue to develop R&D by securing excellent talent in the future.”
LiBEST Presents its Fire Retardant Freeze-resistant Battery Manufacturing Technology in CES 2023
Flexible secondary battery manufacturing start-up LiBEST will showcase its fire retardant freeze-resistant battery manufacturing technology at CES 2023.

It is widely known that the cold sub-zero weather we're seeing these days can deteriorate battery performance. Temperature has a major impact on the runtime of smartphones as well as EVs. According to a LiBEST representative, “Lower temperatures can even disable these vehicles. When such cases happen, people may misinterpret it as a product failure, but for the most part, they are battery problems. Temperature drop results in frozen electrolyte, which in turn leads to lower conductivity of the lithium ion. For this reason, lithium ion batteries typically perform 40 - 70% of their original capacity in sub-zero temperatures.”

LiBEST’s fire retardant freeze-resistant battery manufacturing technology is somewhat different. For the anode and cathode, NMC and graphite are used as usual but their special electrolyte was combined with a separating membrane. That is why the battery maintains its voltage and high energy density while providing fire retardant and freeze-resistant features.

Direct exposure of a typical battery's electrolyte to a flame of about 1,300˚C causes the electrolyte to ignite quickly, and the flame persists until all of the electrolyte is burned away. Under the same condition, LiBEST’s electrolyte takes a longer time to ignite, comparable to incombustible materials. Even when ignited, the flame is soon extinguished, suppressing direct ignition at the battery cell level.

In the case of the battery which LiBEST is currently developing, it even operates at -40˚C, the temperature that disables normal electrolyte, and the battery is normally charged and discharged at –20˚C and –10˚C. Also, this battery with its high energy-density designed for battery electric vehicles (BEVs) retains over 90% capacity, even after 500 charges and discharges.

Narma Introduces Motorized Dual Tiltrotor Drone Optimized for Shipping in CES 2023

Narma, Korea Aerospace Research Institute's first research business, developed the world's first motorized dual tiltrotor drone optimized for shipping. The tiltrotor is capable of vertical take-off and landing as well as high-speed flight, with the ability to load a 5kg payload and fly 40 kilometers in 40 minutes. Among the drone makers in the country, Narma is the only one that has been simultaneously licensed by the government to fly two types of special flights (BVLOS and night flights). Last year, their drone took off in front of the National Assembly building and operated Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) flight across the clusters of buildings in Seoul for a demo flight hosted by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

Although shipping drones are also being developed by global makers, their weight, wind resistance, and shipping costs based on cargo cannot compete with Narma which prides itself on its tiltrotor drones as “by far the best in the world.” Unlike conventional drones piloted by experienced pilots, Narma's drones have the advantage of being able to fly automatically using simple maneuverable devices, such as kiosks, without manual intervention. To reduce manufacturing costs, Narma introduced new technologies to create carbon plates without manual molding, and the new method dramatically reduced manufacturing time and costs, allowing their products to compete with even automobiles and motorcycles.

The maximum speed of the “AF 100” with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) is 120 km/h. It has a wider operating area than multicopter drones, enabling users to control it in real time using a camera. In addition, drones placed in their station will always be ready to take off with their battery charged to 70%.

The business plans to cooperate with a Korean convenience store chain, CU, to start a full-scale drone delivery service in the country. This year, Narma offered drone shipping solutions using its product to several countries, including South Africa, Croatia, Ethiopia, and the Philippines. The company also signed SKD contracts with partners in South Africa and Croatia, realizing its first actual exports. Narma aims to expand its business to North America next year.

This solution features high availability since it can be applied to any device capable of speech recognition, and it is equipped with AI technology that analyzes the cognitive abilities of the subject, immediately providing the results. While commercial drones with similar sizes and specifications typically fly about 60 minutes, PRENEU’s Ruepel can hover for up to 90 minutes. It can also work even in adverse weather conditions and features optimized performance for patrolling, whether it be over the mountains or the sea.

50104.cap: zkVoting, an online voting service based on Zero-Knowledge Proof technology introduced at CES 2023. | Photo by Aving News

50104.x: The demand for reliable and secure elections has never been more apparent than ever. Following the January 6 United States Capitol attack to the most recent siege of Brazil's Capitol, the tension surrounding a just election has been accelerating catastrophically. Indeed, the call for fair elections goes beyond the realm of politics but also includes reality TV shows where only a year ago, the South Korean courts prosecuted two executive producers for rigging votes for a popular K-Pop survival show.

Yet last week, CES, the world's most influential tech event, finally found the answer in a small start-up company called Zkrypto. "zkVoting" is one of Zkrypto’s products, as the world's first public blockchain voting service to ensure complete voter privacy and election transparency. At CES's opening ceremony, Kinsey Fabrizio, CTA's Senior Vice President of Membership, CES Sales, and Marketing, praised zkVoting for its ability to reshape online privacy and anticipated zkVoting's ability to "usher in a whole new era for elections." Furthermore, Fabrizio announced zkVoting as "one of the three breakthrough technologies to influence and solve today's challenges.“

The CES Innovation Awards program honours outstanding design and engineering products that will lead world technologies. In addition to being awarded the Innovation Award from the software and mobile app category, zkVoting is the first ever blockchain service to be selected and recognized with the "Best of Innovation" award.

50104.cap: zkVoting Smartphone Application’s Operating Screen | Photo by Aving News

50104.x: Professor Hyun-ok Oh and Professor Jihye Kim co-founded Zkrypto, which first began as a collaborative research project and later progressed into a start-up to possess Korea's top zero-knowledge-proof schemes and protocols. Zero-knowledge proof is a cryptographic privacy solution that allows a party (the prover) to guarantee the truth of specific information to another party(the verifier) without disclosing any additional information. zkVoting optimizes zero-knowledge proof to protect voters' personal information on the public blockchain whilst validating the correctness of ballot content, allowing individuals to vote with full confidence anytime and anywhere.

Professor Hyun-ok Oh, CEO of Zkrypto, commented, "By creating a permanent proof encryption for a 'one person one vote' scheme, voters can confirm their ballot in the tally but cannot know the identity and location of other voters." He further explains, "The public blockchain allows everyone to check the election process, for example, confirming whether votes are tallied and processed correctly into the ballot box." In fact, Professor Oh shares Kinsey Fabrizio's notion as he referred, "We were delighted to hear that Fabrizio and the behalf of the CTA shared our view that zkVoting will incite an unprecedented legacy for elections. Reducing election costs and ensuring a secure yet valid election will achieve societal transparency that encourages and reflects the people's will and opinion."

Professor Jihye Kim, CTO of Zkrypto, added, "We have also received a lot of attention and support from Web 3.0 industry attendees in our ability to prove that privacy-preserving services in blockchain go beyond and above infamously speculative crypto-related ecosystems. We utilize the succinct security of a public blockchain and resolve previous privacy issues with our zero-knowledge protocol." To end, Professor Kim revealed her ambition: "I will continue my research and wish to optimize zero-knowledge proofs further to tackle privacy concerns in personal data transactions, DIDs and logistics systems to create a safe and secure world.“

50113.cap: Beer tasting process at Aromyx's booth | Photo by AVING News

50113.x: Aromyx - a sensory science and data company - revealed its consumer-facing product suggestion AI technology that biologically replicates the human senses of taste and smell. At the Aromyx's booth, the bartender provided three beer products to every tester. When the tester drank each product, the AI in the tablet recorded the tester's facial expression and questionnaire response on each beer. Aromyx's AI then analyzed videos and reviews from each tester to suggest three beer brands the tester would enjoy.

50113.cap: Introductory Screen of Aromyx's demo designed for beer preference evaluation | Photo by AVING News

50113.x: This technology suggests food, beverage, or fragrance products for consumers based on how a product's taste or smell matches an individual's taste and smell affinities. It identifies how consumers respond to a product in either positive or negative feedback and lists the profiled products that best meet their personal preferences. Unlike other recommendation algorithms, Aromyx's technology weighs on human biological responses to taste and smell and AI, not mere inferences based on other people's purchasing behavior. Aromyx says this unique feature allows for personalized recommendations that are the basis for nuanced product comparisons and selections.

50113.cap: Aromyx's explanation of its AI technology at the end of the demo experience | Photo by AVING News

50113.x: Aromyx conducts lab screening and analysis to objectively measure the target audience's perception of a product's taste or smell. Using the laboratory and data analysis results, Aromyx builds a custom consumer-facing interface to access the customers' extensive product profile database that they then use to query shoppers in search of recommendations for products they will love. The interface queries consumers. Whether in-person or online, shoppers answer questions about their taste and scent preferences. Their responses provide the basis for the product recommendations.

50113.cap: Aromyx's recommendation results after its evaluation | Photo by AVING News

50113.x: "Why guess what consumers will like when you can know? Curating your consumers' decision set can mean the difference between a shopper's confident purchase versus abandoning the intended purchase. Our sensory science helps retailers make data-driven product recommendations that leverage our unique insights about human taste and smell," said Elise Kern, Senior Vice President, Data and Insights, Aromyx. "For the first time, consumers can receive food, beverage, and perfume recommendations based on objective measurements of taste and smell that match each of their preferences and discover products they may not have otherwise."

50117.cap: Simple Labs' Cogni displayed at the booth | Photo by AVING News

Synesso collaborated with YES PLZ COFFEE, the online platform selling a unique blend of coffee roasted weekly. YES PLZ COFFEE says it sources its coffee from every part of the globe to discover a variety of combinations through experiments. After making a fresh release of coffee with quality control every week, it ships the blend to customers and subscribers. Synesso used high-quality stainless steel brew and steam tanks, heat-exchange coil, and dynamic proportional valves for this machine. Valves combine water paths then a heating coil adjusts heat precision every tenth of a second with logic technology - enabling simultaneous coffee brewing and steaming.

Synesso equipped Manual Volumetric Programming (MVP) tech from its commercial machines to ES1, allowing tight-tolerance control over extraction pressure, water flow, and volume. The MVP tech with the onboard pressure/flow graphing helps users to have better control over extraction pre-infusion, infusion, and ramp-down pressure with smooth pressure ramps between each stage.

50129.cap: AramHuvis presented AI-Scalp Grader (AISG) and won CES 2023 Innovation Award. │Photo by Aving News

50129.x: [Las Vegas, U.S. = Aving News] AramHuvis (CEO Dongsoon Park) announced that they participated in CES 2023 held in Las Vegas, U.S. for four days from Thursday, January 5 to Sunday, January 8, 2023 in local time.

Founded in November 2002, AramHuvis has been manufacturing and distributing cosmetic diagnostic devices for skin, scalp, and hair for over 20 years. The experience and knowledge gained while growing with global beauty businesses is now the foundation for customized cosmetics business it pursues. Starting from the partnerships with South Korea's leading hair salon franchises, the company is planning to expand its market while getting ready to build a system that enables everyone in the world to use their unique suitable hair products.
The company aims at providing custom-made solution products to the end consumers, taking advantage of this exhibition as an opportunity to establish a network.

AI-Scalp Grader (AISG) presented at CES 2023 is an AI scalp diagnostic device trained with AramHuvis' exclusive big data and analytical technology. All those seeking scalp care can be provided with custom-made ingredients subdivided into 1 mg depending on their scalp type.

According to an AramHuvis representative, “We have trained artificial intelligence with over 100,000 pieces of biometric data collected with our diagnostic devices over the past 20 years. That led to the development of AISG, a smart system that offers detailed and accurate diagnostic reports based on a picture of the scalp. For business owners in the beauty industry, our products are a very effective way to promote services and attract consumers. AISG also allows average users to get accurate data on their scalp conditions.”

50129.cap: Scalp Diagnosis Demonstration │Photo by Aving News

50129.x: AramHuvis’ hair products created with this AISG technology are made with active ingredients tailored to the individual scalp type. “Solutions to scalp-related problems (dryness, oiliness, sensitivity, seborrhoea, etc.) and their distribution systems were hard to find globally. In contrast, the scalp and hair loss management market is continuously expanding, and issues such as scalp disease and hair loss are also increasingly emerging in younger generation who are socially active in particular. As the demand for individual management based on accurate diagnostic information is expected to increase, we wanted to secure future-readiness and profitability by combining a scalp care system and a solution product,” said the representative.

The representative further explained that “We expect to contribute to the enhancement of the user's standard of living with our scalp diagnostics and custom-made scalp product manufacturing processes using our AI algorithm.”

AramHuvis also reported its achievements from the participation in CES. With the help of its partner Estee Lauder, they succeeded in introducing the system to two U.S. branches who are currently running a pilot project, which is before the stage where practical sales performance can be discussed with display and system.

“There have been a lot of inquiries from end consumers interested in scalp care products as well as business owners who run beauty-related businesses or care products sales businesses from home and abroad, hoping to adopt the diagnostic system quickly.” “As we expect to attract a large number of customers who use AI-Scalp Grader, the demand for convenient diagnostic devices will rise. That is why we developed a small handheld model ECW-CUBE, which is ready for launch. As soon as the sales of AISG are stabilized, it will be distributed as a pilot project in the stores,” the representative explained.

50129.cap: Photo of AramHubis’ booth at CES 2023 │Photo by Aving News

50129.x: “When representatives of our longtime partners and global beauty companies, LOREAL, P&G, and Estee Laude, visited our booth, we had presentations on our products and completed a survey on the adoption of AISG by country. This is an essential foundation for future supply of AISG and custom-made scalp cosmetics. Meaningful discussions have been made beyond our prior expectations,” the representative said.

Meanwhile, AramHuvis services are based on big data and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. AI learning requires a large amount of data, and a variety of data to accumulate. In addition to the data collected on its own, AramHuvis was able to reinforce the performance of their existing AI models by utilizing the open AI learning data through AI-Hub established by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the National Information Society Agency.

Organized by the Ministry of Science and ICT and promoted by the National Information Society Agency, the data building project for AI learning which has built a total of 1,300 types of data will remain open to the public via AI-Hub until 2025. This project has addressed the difficulty in cost-and-time-consuming data building, driving growth of AI SMEs and startups in Korea. The data for AI learning can be accessed and downloaded by the public on the AI-Hub website.

After a couple of updates from 2018, when we began, and up until now, we have successfully accumulated a ton of data. I will not lay out the number, but we have successfully proved our model accuracy to be 95% in both classification and volume estimation."

In Korea, Nuvilab's initial strategy was to target key sectors, such as the Ministry of National Defense, schools, and preschools, in collaboration with the government. The company broadened its reach by partnering with various hospitality groups and food service companies, including Aramark Korea, to offer solutions to different food service operators. In 6th year as a startup aiming for global expansion, Nuvilab said its vision-based AI food recognition and extensive data analysis pinpoint the amount of waste generated, addressing the crucial problem of data optimization in the food industry.

Nuvilab said its AI Food Scanner showcasing at CES 2024 employs an advanced vision AI technology that performs food analysis in just 0.97 seconds, identifying the type and quantity of food on trays and bins to prevent overproduction and reduce carbon emissions.

"What's changed is that it is much more modular and flexible. So, traditionally, we had one model with RGB and depth information. And then now we have a central computer model, the RGB sensor that will be mounted on the top, and then the depth sensor mounted on the bottom. So, per the client's need, it will be the same hardware design. That can be modulated and must be pretty flexible per client," Nuvilab's Ayden said.

"So our technology, again," Nuvilab's Ayden continued, "implements AI and 3D depth sensors to enable accurate processing in real time to infer what type and amount of food item is being presented. This is one of the examples where we implement this technology in the halls. So, the individuals would scan their plates. Then, the AI will infer which items are present, and then the depth analysis will infer how many of what items are being presented.

"It is 3D vision computer provision. It seamlessly integrates into the preexisting kitchen environment or the hall environment. So, in the traditional methods, it would have to weigh the individual trays or the food disposal bins. By implementing vision sensors, we don't need those big hardware to scale or measure those food items. Then, we also allow the food consumption and waste output levels of each food item presented, which can only be succeeded by those vision sensors.

"So first implementation is what we've been doing for the past five years. It's a food tray scanner so that an individual can scan their tray, and then they would know how much they have left and how much carbon output or nutrition intake they have consumed. And then the second thing is relatively new. It has been showcased in a couple of events previously, but it is more focused on the kitchen operation, so instead of scanning the trays, it would be watching the trash bins. The output is the same so that it would give out the information on the depth and the type of the food items. But then, it is more focused on kitchen operation and management so they can better control their stocks. They can predict their covers and the number of diners better. The last one is the automated conveyor and scanner. It is the smallest scanner we have; it will be mounted on the conveyor belt where the environment allows, and then it will automatically scan all the food items being left.

"So the depth of the information we give out has been optimized for each client. Before, it was how much food, nutrition, and waste, but now, we can modulate that for particular needs, depending on the patient's condition and the facility in terms of hospital or long-term care. They can have their models that they can implement. Then, we will have dashboards to optimize and filter through that information.

"As said for different purposes, we have dubbed our solutions for more clarity. So, the diet manager will be our previous nutrition intake manager. So, anything related to nutritional intake and diet control ranges from educational facilities to military long-term care and hospitals. All things related to nutrition and intake will be integrated into the diet manager program. The second thing is that a footprint manager is pretty. Self-explanatory is what we've been doing. And then it's the most substantial basis that we have. It will calculate how much carbon emission is being put out for that specific client or facility. And we're cooperating with Fao and other international organizations to clarify better how to calculate that carbon emission.

"And then, the last thing is the inventory manager. This is geared towards the kitchen so the kitchen managers would have better clarity. In terms of understanding what they need to purchase more, what they need to buy less, and what they can expect regarding the number of customers and diners, our Dataware is designed to enhance the preexisting operators—clarity and data management control a couple of use cases."

Looking ahead to CES 2024, Nuvilab plans to operate a 1,500-square-foot booth, a significant undertaking for a startup. The company hopes the opportunity will allow it to connect more relevantly with our existing and potential clients in diverse sectors as we continue to showcase the impactful role of AI in everyday health, dietary management, and food waste management.

Nuvilab, having secured Series A funding last October, made an impactful debut at CES 2023, attracting attention from prominent companies like Aramark and Sodexo. At CES 2024, it will showcase its innovative solutions, including the AI Food Scanner 3.0 and various management tools (Kitchen Manager, Hall Manager, and Care Manager). These solutions aim to assist in managing Type 2 Diabetes diets and promote sustainability efforts towards net zero. With a strategic focus on expanding into the American and European markets, Nuvilab said it aspires to make significant advancements in these regions.

Procyan is an AI Edutech company aspiring to bridge global disparities in math education. The company aims to enhance learners’ math skills through its adaptive learning service. To achieve this vision, they developed a “Math Calculation Engine,” allowing learners to solve unlimited math problems tailored to their skill levels.

Regarding B2C, Procyan primarily targets middle and high school students worldwide. 50551.x: On December 12th, an ‘Incheon Special Global Press Conference’ occurred at the Incheon Startup Park in Songdo, Incheon.

This global press conference was organized as a promotional event for local startups participating in the CES 2024, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition, to introduce their capabilities to the global media through the support programs provided by the Incheon Startup Park.

Leading this initiative, the Incheon Economic Free Zone Authority (IFEZ) was established in 2003 to develop Incheon into an international economic hub and a center for specialized services. Forming a free economic zone centered around Incheon, IFEZ has been contributing to the city’s development and growth and furthering the national economy. In February 2021, they opened the Incheon Startup Park, positioning it as the ‘nursery of startups.’
Q1: Please introduce IFEZ, responsible for the leap to a global smart city in Incheon.

A: Director Shim Sunok: Understanding the ‘Korean Free Economic Zones’ is crucial. ‘KFEZ’ refers to special economic zones formed to improve the business environment and living conditions for foreign-invested companies by relaxing various regulations to maximize their financial autonomy and attract investment.

Incheon, possessing international harbors and airports, took on this role in 2003, giving birth to the Incheon Economic Free Zone Authority. For 20 years, IFEZ has selected seven future visions such as a Life Science and healthcare City, a Global Education City, a Future Smart City, a K-Contents City, a Startup Venture Polis, an International Financial City, and a Tourism and leisure Hub City, aiming to make Incheon a ‘first-class city’ recognized worldwide, not just in South Korea.
Q2: IFEZ exudes remarkable confidence and pride in Incheon as a smart city. What is the background for this?

A: Director Shim Sunok: IFEZ has been the leading force in transforming Songdo, Yeongjong, and Cheongra—three city zones—into intelligent cities over the past 20 years. Songdo International City is a global hub for advanced knowledge and service industries with facilities like international business districts, knowledge information industrial complexes, and bio-clusters.

Moreover, Yeongjong International City is optimized for logistics and tourism industries with world-class airport facilities. Cheongra International City embodies a new concept of business towns coexisting with business and residential spaces.
IFEZ aims to establish an international-scale advanced service industry hub under the ‘Global Business Frontier’ vision and continue expanding its influence.
Q3: IFEZ announced support for local startups’ participation in CES 2024 under the global smart city strategy. What is the connection between startups’ global stage entry and smart city capabilities?

A: Director Shim Sunok: We believe there is no better place than CES to showcase Incheon’s smart city technological prowess to the world. CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, attracts over 150,000 attendees annually.

Our goal is to imprint Incheon as a city with international competitiveness in the minds of people gathered on this global stage. The technology and systems constituting our city originate from the ideas of innovation companies and startups nurtured by Incheon. If we can demonstrate these in the competitive arena of global tech companies, it validates our competitiveness and fulfills our goal.

Moreover, this is a pivotal platform for startups with limited opportunities for global market expansion compared to established corporations. ‘Bursys,’ an Incheon company that participated in CES 2023, is a good example. It received significant attention after its participation and winning the Best Innovation Award. It even received serious proposals from ‘Warner Bros,’ a content production company, and is collaborating with the metaverse platform ‘ZEPETO,’ boasting 200 million users worldwide.

IFEZ believes in the potential for future startups to become the next supernova after ‘Verses.’ Our role is to support them to translate their potential into tangible results. Hence, we started supporting startups’ participation in CES this year.

Furthermore, IFEZ plans to operate an ‘Incheon/IFEZ Promotion Pavilion within the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) during the exhibition, showcasing products from 34 startups and enhancing Incheon’s bright city image. LVCC is a hub during CES, utilizing the entire city area. As the only local government operating a joint pavilion here, we expect a substantial promotional impact.
Q4: I’m curious about the companies IFEZ and Incheon Startup Park supported for CES 2024 participation and their achievements before the exhibition.

A: Director Shim Sunok: Out of the 30 startups IFEZ and Incheon Startup Park supported for CES participation, 16 received final approval from the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) to enter Eureka Park. Though more companies couldn’t make the list, considering it’s the first attempt, it’s a decent outcome.

Significantly, more than half of the participating startups, 9 out of 16, swept 11 innovation awards at CES 2024. As known, CES Innovation Awards are granted to products and technologies showcasing differentiation and market potential before the exhibition, translating to global market opportunities.

Last year’s Best Innovation Award winner, ‘Verses,’ consecutively won the award with their ‘Bit-based AI Music Video Generator.’ ‘Lordsystem,’ presenting the ‘Trip Pass Mobile Passport Platform,’ won the Best Innovation Award in the financial technology category and the Cybersecurity & Personal Safety category, achieving double victories.

Similarly, startups like ‘Sheco,’ dual winners of the Innovation Award, and ‘TheLittleCat,’ ‘Safeware,’ ‘Microsystems,’ ‘BANF,’ ‘Gole Robotics,’ and ‘K-Rangers (OhMyApp),’ each winning in a category, will shine at Eureka Park during the exhibition.
Q5: What are the future directions and plans of IFEZ post-CES 2024?

A: Director Shim Sunok: IFEZ aims to expand Smart City Incheon’s influence overseas continually. To achieve this, it plans to participate consistently in globally recognized mega exhibitions such as Germany’s IFA (Internationale FunkAusstellung) and Spain’s MWC (Mobile World Congress) to maximize promotional effects. Especially, CES marks the first step in overseas-oriented promotional activities, and we will do our utmost to reap the maximum outcome.

Moreover, while based in Incheon, the authority will continue discovering companies and startups with exceptional capabilities and potential, offering them more opportunities. The dream is to realize symbiotic growth between corporations and the city, paving the way for future developments.

Having received more than 20 certifications and awards, including pre-startup package selection and outstanding company awards from the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, UniUni is expanding domestically and aiming for global market penetration, recently being selected for the Technology Innovation Program for Startups (TIPS) R&D.

At CES, the spotlight will be on the ‘Savvy Toilet,’ a restroom safety solution. Developed to dominate the global market, Savvy Toilet is an AI-based intelligent integrated solution for ‘safe, secure, satisfactory’ restrooms. It enables 24/7 real-time detection and action based on AI, particularly identifying and analyzing abnormal behavior (illegal filming, falls, unusual behavior, etc.) using deep learning. The solution promises a 99.6% identification rate for risky and strange behavior within 4 seconds, immediately notifying administrators upon detection. The features include real-time data collection, accurate data provision via an automated system, object detection mapping, location information provision through object identification, and real-time monitoring of customer behavior information provided in dashboard format via an app service.

A UniUni spokesperson commented, “We possess a technology that improves the accuracy of abnormal behavior detection (over 98%) by applying optimized AI models for behavior recognition. Our high-precision abnormal behavior detection solution, including non-identifiable IoT sensor-based safety and space management features, is unique in Korea. While competing radar technology exists for detecting illegal filming cameras in restrooms, these focus on post-analysis, making real-time responses based on user behavior analysis challenging. Additionally, regarding disaster or accident response products, similar products are limited to simple storage products for emergency supplies in subway stations or emergency bells that can be pressed during emergencies.”

Continuing to expand domestically, UniUni is engaged in joint business expansion with mobile telecommunication operators like KT and DLIVE. Leveraging these collaborations as references, the company seeks partnerships with overseas mobile telecommunication companies to explore various collaboration methods, such as technological cooperation for network setup, establishing joint sales networks, and devising strategies for business expansion. Since IoT devices require network environments and rapid growth, collaboration with these operators is essential.

50561.x: Mokibo (CEO Eunhyung Cho) participates in CES 2024 in Las Vegas from January 9 to 12, showcasing its innovative “Fusion Keyboard,” gaining traction as the next-generation mainstream input device. The keyboard preserves the tactile sensation of mechanical keyboards while transforming into a large touchpad, addressing the shortcomings of virtual keyboards and offering a typing speed advantage. The built-in touchpad on the keyboard is more than three times larger than standard laptop touchpads, enhancing user experience.

Notably, the Fusion Keyboard eliminates the need for a separate mouse. Mokibo has successfully developed and mass-produced this technology, filing over 90 patents worldwide. A Mokibo spokesperson stated, “The Fusion Keyboard innovatively reduces weight and thickness, making it a compact keyboard suitable for portable devices. Additionally, this innovation could reduce the 1,800 tons of mouse plastic waste discarded globally each year.”

The Fusion Keyboard incorporates revolutionary key switch technology, automatically transitioning the keyboard into a large touchpad based on the user’s intent. This 4-in-1 keyboard integrates a keyboard, touchpad, smart device stand, and keyboard cover, employing a non-contact capacitive touch switch. It supports efficient multi-pairing, allowing simultaneous connection to up to three Bluetooth devices. A 2-hour USB-C cable charge provides 60 hours of continuous use. The modern design, which transforms into a smart device stand cover, includes water resistance, lightweight construction, and thinness, offering users convenience and versatility.

Mokibo introduced the first generation of Fusion Keyboard in 2019, followed by a significantly improved second generation in 2022, securing over 2.5 billion KRW in global crowdfunding and gaining recognition for its market potential. 50564.x: BarunBio (CEO Hong Jin-ki) announced that its product, the ‘WE-STIM (Wearable Electric Stimulation) Leggings’ product, was selected as the Innovation Award-winning company in the wearable technology category at CES 2024.

BarunBio is an anti-aging life care solutions company. The company explains the core technology, microelectric energy technology, as an innovative anti-aging technology that utilizes microelectric energy generated in daily movements without the need for batteries or devices, developed through over ten years of research. A BarunBio representative stated, “Our technology offers an innovative way to bring about anti-aging changes in cells without the need for time-consuming cell therapy or new drugs, providing products and solutions for easy and natural anti-aging in everyday life.”

The WE-STIM Leggings, which won the Innovation Award this time, are designed to go beyond simple fashion items and utilize the energy generated from human daily movements for health and well-being. The WE-STIM material applied inside the leggings continuously generates micro electric power according to the body’s signals and delivers it to the muscles. In this regard, the representative explained, “According to exercise experiments, this electric stimulation activates muscles, improving exercise performance by 30% and reducing muscle fatigue by an average of over 6%. It also helps accelerate recovery during rest, reducing muscle pain and swelling associated with everyday activities.”

BarunBio’s technology implements the WE-STIM structure using structural engineering, combining existing clothing materials and conductive fibers. This is explained to effectively deliver the harvested energy from human activity to the body. Therefore, the critical advantage of BarunBio’s wearable solution is that all materials and manufacturing processes can be fiber-based, requiring no additional equipment or wires.

Positive customer reactions have been reported since the product’s market release, especially from customers concerned about leg fatigue or swelling and those who exercise regularly. The product received favorable evaluations for its comfortable fit, material quality, and practicality, differentiating it from conventional electric stimulation leggings. BarunBio anticipates that these technological developments, products, and consumer responses will serve as stepping stones to further stages of technological development, leading to the development of medical devices for anti-aging.

Based on these achievements in the Korean market, BarunBio is expanding its improved product lineup based on consumer feedback, aiming for rapid commercialization to enhance brand recognition.

In addition to strengthening the domestic market, BarunBio is preparing to enter the US market and establish various global strategic partnerships and export plans to provide anti-aging life care solutions worldwide. BarunBio also expects to make contacts with investors who agree and support its plans for product expansion and platform development.

The representative continued, “Reflecting this trend, BarunBio has decided to develop advanced athleisure products suitable for the lifestyle of modern individuals that combine daily life and exercise.” He added, “Users can utilize the energy generated continuously in their daily lives by just wearing and moving, making it our original technology to deliver this energy to the muscles, stimulating cells by transmitting it to the areas they want to stimulate. 50569.cap: OBST BANK (Obesity BANK) showcased by DNA Corporation at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

50569.x: DNA Corporation, headed by CEO Ko Kyung-hwan, felt its presence at the ‘CES Unveiled’ global media event on January 7th, just before the official opening of CES 2024 in Las Vegas. Established in 2019 to provide a better life and a brighter future for children through AI-based DNA data utilization, DNA Corporation has proven its capabilities in AI-based diagnostic solutions. After two years of research, they launched ADHD BANK, a simple screening test for ADHD, which received a CES 2023 innovation award.

Expanding its adaptive range beyond child ADHD, DNA Corporation has now successfully developed OBST BANK (Obesity BANK). This genetic analysis kit, designed through research and exploring biomarkers in obese patients, aims to detect obesity early and provide personalized diagnoses.

OBST BANK is an AI-based DNA data solution that supports physicians in diagnosis and prediction. It utilizes a simple collection method of epithelial cells from infants at birth, which are then directly used for genetic analysis. This function facilitates research into obesity cases with genetic causes, like early childhood obesity.

Recognized for its exceptional functionality and distinction from other solutions, OBST BANK won the AI category innovation award at CES 2024. At CES Unveiled, it received promising evaluations from global attendees.

50571.cap: Two types of the walking and rehabilitation assistive robot 'H-Flex' presented by Hurotics at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

50571.x: Hurotics, a company founded by faculty members of the Chung-Ang University Assistive and Rehabilitation Robotics Lab and led by CEO Lee Gi-wook, participated in the 'CES Unveiled' global media event on January 7th, ahead of the official start of CES 2024 in Las Vegas.

Specializing in biomechanics and custom robotic suit technology, Hurotics has developed robot suits that apply to various walking disorders, showing high utility in medical, sports and leisure, industrial, and military markets.

Expanding its product portfolio into assistive wearable robots, which are in high demand but limited in development and supply, Hurotics sees this as an opportunity to explore global market entry. At CES Unveiled, the company showcased its 'H-Flex' series of walking assist robots, capturing the attention of attendees.

The H-Flex, an advanced soft robotic suit, features high-speed customized control, a compact embedded system, mechanical suit control software, and customized modular technology. Its all-in-one modular driving method fulfills all requirements for self-powered movement, allowing customization of the robotic assistance according to user conditions.

Utilizing H-Flex in the initial walking assist mode can improve walking efficiency by up to 20%. It also boasts excellent flexibility and adjustability to fit users' physical needs and reduces friction at body contact points with its unique dual-folding drive module.

50571.cap: CEO Lee Gi-wook of Hurotics interacting with the international press at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

50571.x: Furthermore, the user-customized software in H-Flex integrates a walking recognition algorithm and functions applicable to various users and environmental variables, personalizing assistance power and patterns within 2 minutes. The dedicated app allows users to track their current status, select preferred rehabilitation modes, and review activities to assess physical improvements.

CEO Lee Gi-wook stated, "We saw Unveiled as the most suitable and effective platform to showcase our products and technology, as it gathers various media and influencers from around the world ahead of CES 2024." He added, "Especially as our company is preparing for a Pre-A investment round, we expect that showcasing the technical capabilities and competitiveness of H-Flex to a broader international audience will aid in future investment attraction. We also aim to gauge the potential price point set just before commercialization through feedback from journalists."

Established in 2017, Smart Geotech specializes in developing and supplying ICT convergence products for disaster safety, focusing on high-sensitivity sensor-based measurement systems using Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The company has developed and provided disaster safety management products such as "Smart Early Warning System for Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)" and "Smart Steel Pipe Multi-Layer System".

With numerous awards, including the IR52 Jang Young Shil Award and the Korea Safety Technology Award, as well as multiple patents and certifications domestically and internationally, Smart Geotech possesses advanced technological capabilities. A representative of Smart Geotech stated, "Our company contributes to building the smart city ecosystem and actively strives to develop Eco-Design products using renewable energy for greenhouse gas reduction under the UN climate change agreement."

He continued, "For effective smart city construction for urban disaster prevention in developing countries, we establish and demonstrate a customized solution that provides early warning for landslides in Sakarya Metropolitan Municipality, Turkey. Through this global demonstration project, we are proving the efficiency and reliability of the ground collapse detection and prediction solution for smart cities nationally."

At CES 2024, Smart Geotech will showcase the intelligent sensor-based displacement measurement system Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS) at 'Eureka Park,' where innovative startup products are gathered.

This effectively reduces casualties and property damage, as explained by the company representative.

50573.x: Sheco Co., Ltd. (CEO Kwon Ki-sung) participated in CES 2024 in Las Vegas from January 9th to 12th.

Sheco uses drones to present a solution for purifying various pollutants in marine and water areas. The company’s self-developed water quality purification drone, ‘Sheco Ark-M,’ is a product that automates the cleaning of contaminants on the water’s surface, traditionally performed manually by ship crew members.

Various industrial pollutants such as oil, wastewater, cargo dust, and harmful algae blooms occur in different environments. Separate facilities, equipment, personnel, and processes are operated to handle each type of pollutant, incurring costs and time. In contrast, Sheco Ark, with its all-in-one design, offers versatility for various contaminants, providing economic efficiency in water quality purification and contributing to national-scale water resource management.

Additionally, Sheco aims to achieve complete autonomy and data disclosure in the overall water quality management system, including surface water pollutant purification drones, AI pollutant recognition cameras, and data collection. The company continuously develops environmentally friendly technologies, aiming to apply clean technology to marine environments, similar to robotic vacuum cleaners inside homes.

A Sheco representative mentioned, “Currently, in Korea, oil spill marine accidents occur approximately 256 times a year, almost every other day. Globally, various water pollution issues are arising, each requiring different experts, personnel, equipment, and processes for handling.” Sheco has addressed these challenges by developing wireless small-scale unified equipment, allowing non-experts to respond immediately to pollution incidents with just 30 minutes of training.

Moreover, Sheco Ark’s purification service differs from conventional pollutant recovery and treatment methods—the traditional way involved absorbing pollutants and water, requiring a cumbersome secondary separation process. In contrast, Sheco Ark developed technology for ‘real-time pollutant separation,’ simultaneously suctioning and separating contaminants and moisture. The separated pollutants are stored in cartridges, while purified water is immediately discharged.

The Sheco representative emphasized, “Sheco Ark is a product that automates water quality management in marine and water areas, a task that previously required ships and personnel. With about 30 minutes of training, even a non-expert can use it immediately. In addition to the product’s automatic solution, our in-house-developed electromagnetic sediment recovery system enables the complete automation of the entire work process without needing personnel.”

Furthermore, “The automation of the work process ensures freedom from health issues such as respiratory, joint, and nervous system diseases caused by contact with pollutants during conventional work. The Sheco Ark does not require additional facilities, ships, heavy equipment, or specialized skills for pollutant recovery. It makes introducing it easy, even when investment in water quality management is challenging, such as small and medium-sized enterprises and developing countries.”

Sheco plans to conduct one proof-of-concept project for water pollution incidents in the North American region in 2024, aiming for international joint development projects to enhance the product and establish a fully autonomous pollution control system.

50574.x: Rovigos (CEO Kim Tae-yong) participated in CES 2024 in Las Vegas from January 9th to 12th.

As an artificial intelligence cloud specialist startup, Rovigos analyzes corporate data and provides data analysis and optimal AI solutions according to customer requests. The solutions address inconveniences arising in various aspects of logistics.

One of the solutions, the TMS (Transportation Management System), utilizes Rovigos AI to reduce management, transportation, and loading costs and derive the most efficient transportation methods in the distribution process. The company explains that it optimizes the distribution process, resolving logistical challenges for logistics companies.

Additionally, Rovigos aims to lead the future logistics industry using UAM (Urban Air Mobility)/drone technology. The company has participated in Korea’s UAM introduction process, the ‘K-UAM Grand Challenge.’ It has the goal of advancing existing control technologies to realize UAM/drone delivery in the future.

Furthermore, Rovigos addresses issues during long-distance maritime transportation through its innovative container solution. Maintaining a consistent temperature is crucial for preserving the value of products such as fresh food or pharmaceuticals during naval transportation. Combining AI and IoT technologies, the solution enables remote control and monitoring.

Regarding this solution, a Rovigos representative mentioned, “We learned that a significant economic loss occurs in the maritime transportation industry due to the disposal of a large amount of food and pharmaceuticals every year. This loss is mainly confirmed due to the failure of temperature and humidity control inside the containers.” The representative explained, “We thought such issues could be resolved if there was a product with real-time monitoring and remote control capabilities. Thus, we created ‘Fresh Guard’ and designed it with a digital twin, communication IoT, and other features to optimize the process.”
The strengths of ‘Fresh Guard’ include remote control of temperature and humidity. It optimizes the container environment remotely, ensuring product quality maintenance and reducing losses.

Moreover, using digital twin technology, the product virtually represents the inside of shipping containers in virtual reality, preventing theft, robbery, and loss. The solution utilizes IoT-equipped satellite modules to monitor the real-time status and conditions of DB-sized containers hourly.

Rovigos, recognized for its technological capabilities, was selected as a ‘Chogokcha Startup’ (Superior Startup) in early August and has also been chosen for collaborative R&D through ‘Chogokcha Startup’ linkage. In October, the company was selected for cooperation with Shinhan Square Bridge (OurHome) and won the Ulsan Port Authority President’s Award.

A representative stated, “Through participation in CES 2024, we aim to introduce our groundbreaking products and solutions to a global audience, receive feedback, and measure market interest. This will contribute to improving our products and customizing them to meet specific demands and preferences of target customers.” The representative added, “We plan to leverage the momentum gained at CES to secure strategic partnerships and collaborations. Additionally, we aim to strengthen research and development initiatives to stay at the forefront of technological innovation within the industry.”

50575.x: KoreaSoft (CEO Nam Yeon-ji) participated in CES 2024 from January 9th to 12th in Las Vegas, USA.

KoreaSoft integrates AI, IoT, and robotics technologies to manufacture and provide smart farm solutions for mass cultivating edible insects. The company also develops and distributes bio-materials using edible insects. With edible insects gaining popularity as an alternative for addressing population growth, greenhouse gas issues, and food security problems due to their high nutritional and environmental value, KoreaSoft advances towards a sustainable future with the slogan “Save the Earth with Insects.”

The smart farm solution aims to support farms that directly produce and sell edible insects or wish to enhance productivity, efficiency, and stable income. The modular facilities of BugsFarm are easily scalable, ranging from a minimum of 45m² to large-scale factories, catering to diverse demands from individual farms to large-scale leased smart farm complexes, according to the company.

A KoreaSoft spokesperson emphasized, “The edible grasshopper, Gom-beng-i, has high pharmacological value in Korea but is sensitive to environmental changes, resulting in significant variations in harvest and price volatility depending on the season. Therefore, our solution development focused on the stable mass production of Gom-beng-i, which is effective in liver health and blood clotting. Through this, we have achieved standardization and scaling of insect quality, allowing even those without experience in insect cultivation to raise them easily with simple training. The All-care service, covering feed to sales, enhances farm income.”

Additionally, the smart farm utilizes AI, IoT, and robotics technology for real-time monitoring and managing environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, light, and ammonia, allowing automatic control of insect breeding, growth, and harvesting processes.

The spokesperson added that the automated feeding and management system maximizes resource efficiency by providing precise nutrients based on the growth stages through modularized automated feeding processes.

Furthermore, the data analysis and prediction system collects and analyzes data through the cloud, monitoring and predicting the status of insects. Applying big data and artificial intelligence technology optimizes productivity and detects potential issues early on.

KoreaSoft has generated its first commercial revenue from BugsFarm by selling research equipment to universities and national research institutes this year. By the end of the year, the company aims to complete a research production facility in a critical regional autonomous area, performing feed-to-product research. In 2024, KoreaSoft plans to initiate a private supply business targeting insect farming enthusiasts and smart farm facilities in essential regions and expand it to other areas. The goal is to achieve facility sales of KRW 20 billion (USD 16 million) by 2027. The company plans to conduct external investment for facility funding in the first half of next year, purchasing a 10,000m² site in an agricultural-industrial complex and completing the construction of a large-scale factory. The production capacity will be expanded to an annual production of up to 1,000 tons by 2028.

KoreaSoft aims to explore new business opportunities in the edible insect smart farm solution and high-performance bio-materials field at CES 2024. The company is determined to secure a foothold for global market entry, increase brand awareness, and enhance its brand image. The spokesperson expressed their commitment to continuous development, improvement, and international expansion of insect industry leadership through advanced solutions and technologies.

50576.cap: FarmPro has announced the development of a SaaS solution named ‘FarmPlusCare,’ combining IoT, big data, AI, and machine learning to help livestock farms reduce the risks of animal diseases and mortality. │Photo provided by FarmPro

50576.x: FarmPro participated in CES 2024 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

FarmPro has developed a SaaS solution named ‘FarmPlusCare,’ combining IoT, big data, AI, and machine learning to help livestock farms reduce the risks of animal diseases and mortality. Additionally, ‘FarmKing’ is a smart artificial insemination device that replaces traditional methods.

Founded on CEO Park Byung-ok’s over ten years of experience operating livestock farms, FarmPro aimed to address the challenges of infectious diseases and repeated breeding and death cycles in densely populated spaces. The development of ‘FarmPlusCare’ stemmed from the desire to monitor the health of livestock, prevent fatal infectious diseases in advance, and achieve minimal animal welfare.

FarmPlusCare monitors the health status of livestock in real-time, preventing diseases and enhancing productivity. Using IoT ear tag devices attached to the animals, data is collected every 10 minutes. The big data analysis algorithm predicts health, estrus, and calving times, providing timely notifications to farmers through a dedicated web platform and mobile application. FarmPlusCare reduces livestock mortality rates, increases farm productivity, and prevents unnecessary deaths by predicting diseases early, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and antibiotic usage. Notably, FarmPlusCare is highlighted as the only device that allows real-time observation of the health status of newborn livestock immediately after birth.

An official stated, “FarmPlusCare can measure the body temperature of livestock with an accuracy of 0.1°C, with a deviation of only 0.5 degrees. It can simultaneously measure real-time movement and body temperature, making it practical and user-friendly, even for beginners. In addition, it possesses a high market competitiveness with a reasonable price.”

50576.cap: Smart Artificial Insemination Device ‘FarmKing’ │Photo provided by FarmPro

50576.x: Furthermore, ‘FarmKing’ is described as a safe and fast artificial insemination device, enabling convenient and hygienic artificial insemination. Its built-in temperature sensor and camera can anticipate disease symptoms, allowing remote monitoring with veterinarians through online networks. It is also praised for its high pregnancy rate, enabling real-time tracking and artificial insemination without needing experts.

50577.x: Mondrian AI (CEO Hong Dae-ui) participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

Mondrian AI, with researchers who are Ph.D. graduates from KAIST at its core, provides data analysis and artificial intelligence services. The company has led in building AI infrastructure, developing predictive models, and creating specialized AI solutions. It has received honors such as the Prime Minister’s Award and Incheon Mayor’s Award and has been selected as one of the top 100 AI companies for four consecutive years.
